integrity: Derivation is analytic and fully stated; numerical checks are supplementary and not evidence of global infinite correctness or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only n unit disks with centers equally spaced on a concentric circle are optimized, not unrestricted disk-n-gons; r in (0,1), p,q>0, n>=3. Asymptotic error bounds are for fixed r,p,q. Unindexed prior treatments remain possible.
title: Unique optimal two-sided disk approximation within rotationally symmetric disk-polygons
